text: Nearby Jolted Enemies take 300% of your Maximum Life as Lightning Damage per Second. Deals More Damage equal to your Lightning Ailment Effect.
translation: 附近的感电敌人每秒承受你最大生命300%的闪电伤害。造成等同于你闪电异常效果的更多伤害。

text: The Rogue class prioritizes dealing high damage with speed as it's main source of defense.
translation: 游侠职业以速度作为主要防御手段，优先造成高额伤害。

text: The Battlemage is adept at dealing damage with both Attacks and Spells.
translation: 战斗法师擅长以攻击与法术造成伤害。

text: The Shaman commands the power of nature to slay it's foes.
translation: 萨满驾驭自然之力斩杀敌人。

text: Inflict a high damage bleed on an enemy.
translation: 对敌人施加高伤害流血。

text: Leave a trail of toxic poison in your wake. All damage dealt by Plague Clouds is affected by Toxic Ailment Effect.
translation: 在你身后留下一道剧毒踪迹。瘟疫之云造成的所有伤害受毒素异常效果影响。

text: Curse enemies in an area with Hinder, reducing their movement speed by 30%.
translation: 以缓速诅咒一片区域的敌人，使其移动速度降低30%。

text: Curse enemies in an area with Scorch, lowering their Fire Resistance by 10%.
translation: 以灼烧诅咒一片区域的敌人，使其火焰抗性降低10%。

text: Curse enemies in an area with Bane, lowering their Toxic Resistance by 10%.
translation: 以灾厄诅咒一片区域的敌人，使其毒素抗性降低10%。

text: Curse enemies in an area with Hyptothermia, lowering their Cold Resistance by 10%.
translation: 以低温诅咒一片区域的敌人，使其冰冷抗性降低10%。

text: Fires a mother shark at a nearby enemy, releasing a burst of dangerous baby sharks at nearby enemies.
translation: 向附近敌人发射母鲨，朝附近敌人释放一波危险的小鲨鱼。

text: Swing a Lightning Infused Axe in an arc towards nearby enemies.
translation: 向附近敌人挥出一记灌注闪电的弧形斩击。

text: You and nearby allies move faster.
translation: 你和附近的盟友移动得更快。

text: You and nearby allies have a reduced chance to be inflicted by ailments.
translation: 你和附近的盟友受到异常状态的几率降低。

text: You and nearby allies gain Evasion.
translation: 你和附近的盟友获得闪避。

text: You and nearby allies gain More Damage.
translation: 你和附近的盟友获得更多伤害。

text: You and nearby allies gain bonuses with Lightning Damage.
translation: 你和附近的盟友获得闪电伤害加成。

text: You and nearby allies gain bonuses with Fire Damage.
translation: 你和附近的盟友获得火焰伤害加成。

text: You and nearby allies gain bonuses with Damage over Time.
translation: 你和附近的盟友获得持续伤害加成。

text: Release an explosion of Boiling Blood, dealing base 250% of your Maximum Life as Fire Damage to nearby Enemies. Blood Burst always inflicts Burn.
translation: 释放沸血爆炸，对附近敌人造成基于你最大生命250%的火焰伤害。沸血爆发必定施加灼烧。

text: Skill fires extra projectiles, each dealing less damage.
translation: 技能发射额外投射物，每个造成更少伤害。
投射物以增加的速度飞行。

text: Inflict Lightning to nearby enemies when hitting Jolted enemies.
translation: 命中感电敌人时，对附近敌人施加闪电。

text: Skill deals more damage with Burns, and has a higher chance to inflict Burn.
translation: 技能对灼烧目标造成更多伤害，并有更高几率施加灼烧。

text: Skill is cast at a faster rate
translation: 技能以更快的速度施放

text: Skill converts some Physical damage into Fire Damage
translation: 技能将部分物理伤害转化为火焰伤害
技能造成更多冰冷伤害

text: Lightning Damage with skill penetrates Lightning Resistance on enemies.
translation: 技能的闪电伤害穿透敌人的闪电抗性。

text: Ailments inflicted by this skill last longer.
translation: 此技能造成的异常状态持续更久。

text: Skill has more effect of curses.
Burns and Chars inflicted by this skill have increased effect.
translation: 此技能造成的灼烧与焦炭效果增加。
力量提供附加物理伤害。
智慧提供附加冰冷伤害。
灵巧提供附加毒素伤害。

text: Skill is cast when hitting an enemy with any non-triggered skill. Skill consumes a random number of Boons to deal 20% more damage for each consumed Boon. Must have at least one active boon to cast. Skill does not auto cast, and cannot trigger other skills. All Triggered skills have a 100ms cooldown.
translation: 用任意非触发技能命中敌人时施放此技能。技能消耗随机数量的赐福，每消耗一个赐福造成20%更多伤害。施放时必须至少有一个激活的赐福。技能不会自动施放，也无法触发其他技能。所有被触发技能均有100毫秒冷却。

text: Deal massive damage with Lightning Skills.
translation: 用闪电技能造成巨量伤害。

text: Freeze your enemies with Cold Skills.
translation: 用冰冷技能冰冻你的敌人。

text: Damage enemies with a powerful bow attack.
translation: 用强力箭矢攻击伤害敌人。

text: Chance to apply Vulnerable on Hit
translation: 命中时施加易伤的几率

text: Chance to gain Toughness Boon when Hit
translation: 命中时获得坚韧赐福的几率

text: Physical Damage as Extra Added Lightning Damage per Swiftness Boon
translation: 每个迅捷赐福将物理伤害额外附加为闪电伤害

text: Increased Area of Effect per Swiftness Boon
translation: 每个迅捷赐福增加范围效果
每25点体质增加火焰伤害
每个精准赐福增加冰冷伤害
每个精准赐福增加伤害
每个迅捷赐福增加投射物速度

text: Physical Damage Converted to Fire Damage
translation: 物理伤害转化为火焰伤害

text: Lightning Damage Converted to Toxic Damage
translation: 闪电伤害转化为毒素伤害

text: Physical Damage as Extra Added Lightning Damage
translation: 物理伤害额外附加为闪电伤害

text: Lightning Damage as Extra Added Cold Damage
translation: 闪电伤害额外附加为冰冷伤害

text: Cold Damage as Extra Added Toxic Damage
translation: 冰冷伤害额外附加为毒素伤害

text: Physical Damage taken as Fire Damage
translation: 受到的物理伤害视为火焰伤害

text: Lightning Damage taken as Toxic Damage
translation: 受到的闪电伤害视为毒素伤害

text: Cold Damage as Extra Added Fire Damage against Frozen Enemies
translation: 对冰冻敌人造成冰冷伤害时额外附加为火焰伤害

text: The toxin had a metallic shimmer.
Fire burns hotter in a bigger heart.
translation: 火焰在更炽热的心中燃烧得更旺。

text: A feverish cold comes over your foes.
translation: 一阵狂热的寒冷笼罩你的敌人。

text: A token of the Ancient Spirit.
Skill has a 10% chance to cast when another skill inflicts a killing blow. Skill does not auto cast, and cannot trigger other skills.
translation: 其他技能造成致命一击时，此技能有10%几率施放。技能不会自动施放，也无法触发其他技能。

text: Skills cost 10% of your Maximum Life per Cast, gaining half as much as Added Physical Damage. Supported Skills cannot be cast if you lack the required Life Cost.
translation: 每次施放技能消耗你最大生命的10%，并获得其一半数额的附加物理伤害。若你缺乏所需的生命消耗，辅助技能将无法施放。

text: Poisons and Infections deal Damage 20% faster.
translation: 中毒与感染造成的伤害加速20%。

text: Every 3 seconds, gain a Phantom Shield up to a maximum of 1. When you will be hit, you instead avoid getting hit, consuming the Phantom Shield. Phantom Shields cannot block Damage over Time.
translation: 每3秒获得一个幻影护盾，最多1个。当你即将被命中时，改为避免被命中，并消耗此幻影护盾。幻影护盾无法格挡持续伤害。

text: Take 10% Less Damage if you have been hit in the past 5 seconds.
translation: 若你在过去5秒内被命中，受到的伤害减少10%。

text: Gain 30% More Armor if you've been hit in the past 5 seconds
translation: 若你在过去5秒内被命中，获得30%更多护甲

text: Damage over Time does not deal Damage, but instead stores Damage as potential energy on the enemy. When the enemy is killed, 15% of stored Damage is released in a large explosion as Physical Damage around the enemy.
translation: 持续伤害不再直接造成伤害，而是将伤害作为势能储存在敌人身上。当敌人被击杀时，15%的储存伤害以物理伤害在该敌人周围引发大爆炸。

text: Skills pierce twice as many enemies
translation: 技能穿透的敌人数量翻倍

text: Damage over Time deals damage 40% faster
Skills have a 10% chance to fire double projectiles
translation: 技能有10%几率发射双倍投射物

text: Enemies Killed have a 30% Chance to Explode dealing 10% of their Maximum Life as Toxic Damage to nearby Enemies
translation: 被击杀的敌人有30%几率爆炸，对附近敌人造成其最大生命10%的毒素伤害

text: While you have your maximum Boons, deal 40% More Damage
translation: 当你拥有最大赐福时，造成40%更多伤害

text: Nearby Enemies count as Poisoned. Nearby Enemies deal 20% Less Damage.
translation: 附近敌人视为中毒。附近敌人造成的伤害降低20%。

text: Charred Enemies take 40% More Fire Damage.
translation: 焦炭状态的敌人受到40%更多火焰伤害。

text: You take 20% Less Damage from Cursed Enemies.
translation: 你受到被诅咒敌人的伤害降低20%。

text: Damage penetrates 25% Fire Resistance against Chilled Enemies
translation: 对冰缓敌人穿透25%火焰抗性

text: Gain 5% of Maximum Life as Added Fire Damage
translation: 获得最大生命5%的附加火焰伤害

text: Gain a Swiftness Boon when you lose a Precision Boon.
translation: 当你失去精准赐福时，获得迅捷赐福。
击杀250名敌人以完成关卡
